levels.name: Wrong turn
levels.sol: F F F R F F
levels.start: F F F L F F
levels.hint: The robot turns the wrong way. Find that turn and fix it.

levels.name: Count again
levels.hint: The robot stops one square too soon. Check the Repeat numbers.

levels.name: Inside or out?
levels.hint: One block is outside the Repeat. Should it be inside?

levels.name: Short F1
levels.sol: f R f L f|F F F
levels.start: f R f L f|F F
levels.hint: F1 is one step too short. Fix F1 and every use of it gets better.

levels.name: Dizzy robot
levels.hint: The robot gets dizzy at the corner. What should it do there?

levels.name: Spinning
levels.hint: The robot spins too much at each corner. Take one block away.

levels.name: Mixed up
levels.hint: The If is mixed up. Which block belongs on which side?

levels.name: Two bugs
levels.sol: r2(f) F r3(f)|F R F L
levels.start: r2(f) F r2(f)|F R F R
levels.hint: Two bugs this time: one in the program and one in F1.

levels.name: Missed turning
levels.hint: The robot walks straight past the turning and bumps.

levels.name: One too few
levels.hint: The robot turns one square too soon and bumps.

levels.name: Missing pixel
levels.hint: The last square of the L stays blank.

levels.name: Rock hopper
levels.sol: F f F F f|L F R F F R F L
levels.start: F f F f F|L F R F F R F L
levels.hint: The robot's second hop bumps into the water.

levels.name: Two arches
levels.hint: The second robot steps onto its gem but does not turn.

levels.name: Look before you leap
levels.hint: The robot checks the way is clear, then bumps anyway.

levels.name: Four arms
levels.hint: The robot walks up and down one arm and never tries the others.

levels.name: Wiggle stairs
levels.hint: After one stair, the robot stands still and wiggles for ever.

levels.name: Hand on the wall
levels.hint: At the first left-hand corner, the robot turns round and walks back.

levels.name: Paint a cup
levels.sol: r3(F P) L r2(F P) L r2(F P)
levels.start: r3(F P) R r3(F P) L r2(F P)
levels.hint: Two bugs: the robot paints outside the cup in two places.

levels.name: Dizzy corners
levels.hint: Two bugs! Each robot gets dizzy at a different kind of corner.

levels.name: Triple trouble
levels.sol: r3(F) r2(f) u(F k(R)())|R F L F
levels.start: r4(F) r2(f) u(F j(R)())|R F R F
levels.hint: Three bugs: the robot bumps before the stairs, on them and at the top.
